# Offline report dependencies

- Chart.js 4.5.1: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js`
- Bootstrap 5.3.8 CSS: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css`

Both are MIT licensed; license files are included here and upstream copyright headers are retained. The report embeds these pinned files so recipients do not need a network connection. Bootstrap JavaScript is not needed. The chart runtime uses source-defined data, escapes embedded JSON and retains static evidence/data-table fallbacks.
